title: Event selection report
description: One row of data/curated/event-selection.jsonl: every source event the build considered, and what the committed rule in tools/dataset/rules/event-selection.json did with it. This is what makes a rejection visible rather than absent — the reason itself is not duplicated here, it lives in the rule file under `rule`/`key`.

id.description: Same canonical ID as events.jsonl, so a rejection and an include cannot disagree about identity.

league.description: Source League verbatim; empty when the source records none.

region.description: Source Region verbatim; empty when the source records none, which is why unknown-region rejection exists.

rule.description: Which clause of the committed rule decided this event, in the order the rule is evaluated.

key.description: The entry inside that clause: a league key, an exclusion key, or an override marker.
